title: 跨时区交接工作，怎样把信息交代完整
topic: 跨时区交接工作，怎样把信息交代完整

source.title: Communicate Handoffs Across Time Zones - Dropbox
source.license: 原文按项目方确认的授权收录
source.context: 原文出自 Dropbox 公开资料。
paragraphs: Step 1: Evaluate team processes Even if you’re not directly handing off work to another person, taking a few minutes to share a brief end-of-day update is an effective async best practice for distributed teams. These updates help teams summarize progress, raise questions, or ask for feedback. They also help cross-functional teams in different time zones stay informed and aligned on the current status of projects. While formal handoffs may not apply to every workflow, they can be highly effective in certain contexts. For example, engineering teams may benefit from handoffs in Kanban-style work (a visual workflow method that uses boards and columns to track tasks through stages), during high-severity incidents that require rapid debugging, or in on-call support roles to ensure seamless coverage and faster response times. Step 2: Schedule time to make a handoff In a “follow-the-sun” workflow—where global teams in different time zones collaborate to maintain around-the-clock progress—it's helpful to block time at the end of the workday to collect salient information the next shift will need. In addition to sharing project updates, it’s a good idea to ask the recipient to flag any blockers they’re facing and request any details that would make the handoff smoother. This simple, shared habit keeps everyone aligned and workflows running seamlessly across time zones.

Step 3: Establish clear handoff processes Teams should define specific handoff protocols that outline how work will transition between different time zones, and agree on a cadence that works for everyone. Keep updates short, easy to understand, and delivered in a consistent format, whether it’s a quick note or short video. Post updates in one go-to place, like your project doc or team channel, so nothing gets lost. In fact, 73% of Dropboxers say clear communication and documentation are the most effective ways to support asynchronous collaboration with colleagues across time zones. Step 4: Iterate on format As teams bond and get more comfortable with workflows, it’s worth periodically checking in to see how the handoff documentation can be sharpened, shortened, and improved. Hold quarterly retrospectives to identify what is working well and what can be improved in the collaboration process. For instance, you might realize one big handoff isn’t cutting it anymore—and that smaller, functional ones work better.
translations:
步骤1：检查团队流程。即使没有把具体工作交给某个人，分布式团队也可以在每天结束时发一条简短更新，汇报进展、提出问题或征求意见，帮助不同时区的跨职能同事了解项目状态。正式交接并非适用于所有流程，但在某些场景很有用，例如工程团队采用看板流程时、处理需要快速排查的严重故障时，或安排值班支持以保证有人接续、及时响应时。

步骤2：安排交接时间。在“追日”工作模式中，全球团队跨时区接力推进工作。可以在下班前留出时间，整理下一班同事需要的关键信息。除了同步项目进度，也请接手者指出他们遇到的阻碍，并提出让交接更顺畅所需的信息。这个简单的共同习惯能让团队保持同步，让跨时区协作顺利衔接。

步骤3：建立明确的交接流程 团队应定义具体的交接协议，概述工作将如何在不同时区之间过渡，并商定适合每个人的节奏。保持更新简短、易于理解，并以一致的格式呈现，无论是快速笔记还是短视频。将更新发布在一个固定的地方，如您的项目文档或团队频道，以免遗漏信息。事实上，73%的Dropbox员工表示，清晰的沟通和文档是与跨时区同事进行异步协作的最有效支持方式。步骤4：迭代格式 随着团队熟悉工作流程并更加适应，值得定期检查交接文档如何能够更加精炼、简化和改进。每季度进行回顾会议，以确定协作过程中哪些方面运作良好，哪些方面可以改进。例如，您可能会意识到一个大型的交接已经不够用了——而更小、功能性的交接效果更好。

notes.phrase: These updates help teams summarize progress, raise questions, or ask for feedback.
notes.meaning: 更新进展、提出问题或请求反馈
notes.explain: 简短的日终更新可以承载这三类信息。
notes.example: My update summarizes progress and asks for feedback on one open question.

notes.phrase: collect salient information the next shift will need
notes.meaning: 整理下一班工作所需的关键信息
notes.explain: salient 指对接手工作最重要的信息。
notes.example: Collect the salient information before handing the case to the next shift.

notes.meaning: 指出接手人目前遇到的阻碍
notes.explain: flag 在工作沟通中表示明确提醒对方注意某个问题。
notes.example: Please flag any blockers before the handoff.

notes.phrase: Keep updates short, easy to understand, and delivered in a consistent format
notes.meaning: 让更新简短、易懂并保持格式一致
notes.explain: 固定格式便于不同班次快速找到需要的信息。
notes.example: Keep the handoff note short and use the same format each day.

scenario.title: The next time zone takes over
english: At the end of her Shanghai workday, Mei has tested the checkout flow but has not resolved a payment error. Her London colleague will continue the investigation.
A message saying “still broken” would force the next team to start over. Mei records what she tested, what failed, the error link, and the next action she recommends.
She asks her colleague to flag any missing information before starting. The work can continue while Mei is offline.
chinese: 上海工作日结束时，Mei 已测试结账流程，但支付错误尚未解决。伦敦同事将接手排查。
如果只发一句“还是坏的”，接手团队就得从头查起。Mei 记录已测试内容、失败点、错误链接以及建议的下一步。
她请同事在开始前指出缺失信息。即使 Mei 离线，工作也能继续。

firstAttempt.prompt: 你要把未解决的支付问题交给伦敦同事。请用英文写清当前状态、下一步负责人、客户回复时限，以及最新文件的位置。
firstAttempt.sample: The checkout test is complete, but payment still fails after confirmation. Alex owns the next check, and the client needs an update before 10 a.m. London time. The error log and latest test results are in the shared ticket.
firstAttempt.rationale: 交接信息要让接手同事知道问题进展、谁继续处理、何时回复客户，以及去哪里找材料。

words.example: A clear handoff lets the next shift continue the investigation.
words.translation: 清楚的交接让下一班能继续排查。
words.note: 强调任务从一人转到另一人。

words.example: We communicate intentionally across time zones.
words.translation: 我们跨时区沟通时会有意识地安排信息。
words.note: 说明做法经过设计而非随手转发。

words.example: Please flag blockers in the ticket.
Include only the salient information in the handoff.
words.translation: 交接中只写最关键的信息。
words.note: 用于筛选接手人必需的内容。

words.example: The handoff helps maintain coverage overnight.
words.translation: 交接有助于夜间持续有人跟进。
words.note: 此处不是新闻报道的 coverage。

words.meaning: 信息一致的；目标一致的
words.example: Daily updates keep the teams aligned.
words.translation: 每日更新让团队信息保持一致。

structure.original: These updates help teams summarize progress, raise questions, or ask for feedback.
analysis: 主语是 These updates，指前文提到的日终更新。
help teams 后接三个并列动词：summarize、raise、ask，列出更新可以承担的不同作用。
ask for feedback 与 summarize progress、raise questions 并列，说明更新不仅用于报告状态，也能请求回应。
structure.transfer: To keep the investigation moving, I’ve linked the error log and listed the next test in the ticket.

rewrite.bad: The replacement is still not sorted. Please take a look.
rewrite.good: The replacement request is under review, and Priya owns the next check. The customer needs an update before 3 p.m. Singapore time. The latest screenshots and case notes are in the shared ticket.
rewrite.translation: 换货申请正在核查，Priya 负责下一步。客户需要在新加坡时间下午三点前收到更新。最新截图和案例记录在共享工单里。
rewrite.pattern: [Current status]. [Owner] owns the next check. The customer needs an update by [time and time zone]. The latest files are in [location].

cloze.prompt: The replacement request is under review. Priya owns the next ___.
cloze.why: 交接时写清后续由谁做什么。

cloze.prompt: The customer needs an update before 3 p.m. Singapore ___.
cloze.why: 标出客户所在时区的回复期限。

cloze.prompt: The latest screenshots and case notes are in the shared ___.
cloze.why: 给接手同事指出最新文件的位置。

dictation.text: To keep work moving and avoid missed details, it’s essential to communicate handoffs clearly and intentionally.
dictation.why: 听清句首目的和句末两个副词。

dictation.text: The error log is linked in the ticket; please check the gateway response next.
dictation.why: 抓住证据位置和下一步动作。

translationPractice.answer: The replacement request is under review, and Priya owns the next check.

translationPractice.prompt: 客户需要在新加坡时间下午三点前收到更新。
translationPractice.answer: The customer needs an update before 3 p.m. Singapore time.

translationPractice.prompt: 最新截图和案例记录在共享工单里。
translationPractice.answer: The latest screenshots and case notes are in the shared ticket.

choice.prompt: 你要把换货问题交给新加坡同事接手。请选择信息完整、方便对方继续处理的交接消息。
options: The replacement is still not sorted. Please take a look.
The replacement request is under review, and Priya owns the next check. The customer needs an update before 3 p.m. Singapore time. The latest screenshots and case notes are in the shared ticket.
I handled this earlier today. I’ll explain the details when we are both online.
choice.why: 消息交代当前状态、负责人、客户时限和资料位置，接班同事可以直接继续。

output.prompt: 你在伦敦下班前把一个换货问题交给新加坡同事。换货申请正在核查，Priya 负责下一步，客户要求在新加坡时间下午三点前收到更新；截图和记录已放入共享工单。请写一条英文交接消息。
output.sample: The replacement request is under review, and Priya owns the next check. The customer needs an update before 3 p.m. Singapore time. The latest screenshots and case notes are in the shared ticket.
check: 是否说明当前状态和负责人？
是否写明客户回复时限及其时区？
是否指出接手人可查看的最新资料？
